zh.name: 血契猎杀
zh.desc: 自从阴险的石像鬼氏族开始招募更多血族后，家化的凤凰氏族必须跟上对方的脚步。结果两个氏族在成员和领地扩充太快的情况下，造成了彼此的不信任、勾心斗角和背叛。随之而来的战争让无数的永生者陨落，而双方氏族巨大的损失也迫使族长们陷入逃亡的的窘境。

zh.name: 一夜终极狼人
zh.desc: One Night Ultimate Werewolf is a fast game for 3-10 players in which everyone gets a role: One of the dastardly Werewolves, the tricky Troublemaker, the helpful Seer, or one of a dozen different characters, each with a special ability. In the course of a single morning, your village will decide who is a werewolf...because all it takes is lynching one werewolf to win!

zh.name: 忍者之夜
zh.desc: Night of the Ninja is a fast-paced game of deadly secrets, midnight assassinations, and paper-thin alliances. In Night of the Ninja, your mission is to defeat a rival ninja House ...if you can figure out who they are! Each round, you choose your ninja role: a Spy or Fortune Teller gains valuable information, but only a Shinobi or Blind Assassin can cut down an opponent. To win, you’ll have to trick your opponents, figure out who can’t be trusted, and fight for your House!

zh.name: 魔城马车
zh.desc: 任何人都感受到马车夫想要赶着达目的地的心，因为马车中的乘客们带着沈重的表情，他们分属於两个最有力的组织，且试图在赶旅程结束前找出自己的伙伴，他们藉由传递神秘信物来得知情报及讯息，且要和同伴在安全的情况下，找到并带着足够的目标宝物，方可获得胜利。

zh.name: 染·钟楼谜团
zh.desc: 《染》是一款社交游戏，它有关推理与欺骗，谎言与逻辑，谋杀与神秘。游戏支持5至20位玩家进行游戏。在白天时，玩家们以集体讨论或私聊的方式进行交流来收集信息，分享情报，或是散布谎言。在夜晚来临后，玩家们会闭上双眼，恶魔和爪牙则会醒来并在镇上作祟。

zh.name: 山中小屋：第三版
zh.desc: 合作棋盘游戏《山屋惊魂：第三版》包括 50 个鬼屋和几十个充满危险的房间，即使是最强壮的人也会感到害怕。一开始，你们会一起合作，但要小心......一个探险家会背叛其他人，然后鬼屋就开始了。

zh.name: 花砖物语
zh.desc: 花砖物语是一款讲述葡萄牙国王 Manuel 一世一次去西班牙串门，在参观阿尔罕布拉宫时被内部的装潢震惊，回国后觉得自己就是个土鳖，于是匆匆召集全国上下的艺术家，准备山寨，哦不，向西班牙艺术家致敬！而你们扮演的，就是这些贴瓷砖的艺术家。

zh.name: 行动代号
zh.desc: 《行动代号》是一款比拼团队默契、考验语言表达的聚会桌游。

zh.name: 箱庭喵喵
zh.desc: 这是一座由喵喵们共同建设、生活，名为“箱庭城”的城市。每一栋建筑都由喵喵们最喜爱的箱子组成。

zh.name: 大吃1墩
zh.desc: 《大吃11》是一款多人欢乐聚会卡牌游戏,游戏胲心肌制为吃墩,佁称跟色出牌,谁出的牌大则可以获得当回舍其他玩家所出牌,即为吃墩。

zh.name: 命悬一线：彩虹版
zh.desc: 命题一線 彩虹版》是一款根據問題選擇恰當的“比喻”来表现自己手上的数字，然後按照從小到大的顺序排列所有玩家的数字的遊戲。

zh.name: 出包魔法师
zh.desc: 一群贪婪的魔法师们来到了传奇大魔法师之塔前，他们使出法力施展强大的咒语，想要赶走他们的竞争者，然后成功地得到先人留下来的咒语。等等……这是怎么回事？火球术居然失败了！结果变成冰冻风暴，还下了一块温柔的春雨！

zh.name: 深海谍影（2022）
zh.desc: In Captain Sonar, you and your teammates control a state-of-the-art submarine and are trying to locate an enemy submarine in order to blow it out of the water before they can do the same to you. Every role is important, and the confrontation is merciless. Be organized and communicate because a captain is nothing without his crew: the Chief Mate, the Radio Operator, and the Engineer.

zh.name: 破晓之前
zh.desc: 黎明时分是当地公墓最繁忙的时刻

zh.name: 烂鱼充数
zh.desc: 通过浑水摸鱼的方式来快速打出手牌，管理好自己的表情，小心被其他人揭穿!如果你不慎在“作弊”时候露出一丝不经意的尴尬，可能会收获一大堆烂鱼卡牌!

zh.name: 工业革命：伯明翰
zh.desc: 英国是第一个开启工业革命的国家。工业革命首先发生在英国的纺织业，而不是别的国家或别的产业，因为英国政府通过长期的不懈努力和奋发图强，为英国企业创造了全球最大的纺织品市场，羊毛和棉花原材料供应和生产基地，以及遍布全球的销售网络。第一次工业革命的繁荣，促进了陶瓷，啤酒和加工产业的发展，造成了对新型能源、动力和运输的巨大的需求，传统的能源-动力-运输方式远远不够用了，因此在英国政府财政支持下，煤炭-蒸汽机-铁路有了爆炸式的发展，工业革命伯明翰正是在这种背景下展现出的一段传奇故事。

zh.name: 艺术名流
zh.desc: 在《艺术名流》中，你是一个艺术鉴赏家，试图通过收集最时尚的艺术收藏品来打动你的同龄人！竞拍最热门的艺术作品，然后把它们摆放在客厅的墙上，成为当地艺术界羡慕的有品位的画廊。

zh.name: 天方：雄与贤
zh.desc: 《天方：雄与贤》这款游戏是对伊斯兰各国黄金时代以及亚洲西南地区历史的演义。这一历史时期，西亚地区涌现了诸多学者，他们的新奇发明和科学发现让世人瞩目。此时的王宫里，苏丹和他的臣子意识到知识的力量，决定利用学者来加强自己的统治，垄断知识阶层并攫取更多利益；但是，一批民间有识之士看穿了苏丹的意图，反对苏丹将学者收为己用，并帮助学者，将他们的科研成果用于人民福祉。

zh.name: Krom: Evolution
zh.desc: 村长失踪了。恐慌！部落需要一个新首领，但这一次，只要是新首领，就必须是聪明的（就像其他人说的那样，它会改变），以便让整个人类物种进化（就是这样）！当然，这个聪明的脑袋是你的！除了其他人也这么认为外，在克罗姆人中感觉就像是在战斗。

zh.name: 猜心俱乐部
zh.desc: 全球各地的旅行者都聚集在这里相互竞争。他们的脸上都带著不可思议的笑容，并邀请你加入他们的游戏。谁拥有最聪明的头脑，成为笑到最后的猜心胜利者？

zh.name: 榛品交易
zh.desc: 作为松鼠团伙的一员，您必须走私非法榛果货物，躲避海关官员，保护您的货品，并为潜在的警察突袭做好准备!一旦有人将手牌用尽，获得最多榛果的团队成为最富有的帮派!

zh.name: 卡波
zh.desc: Spy, swap, and peek to find Cabo the unicorn in this simple card game.

zh.name: 百万美金
zh.desc: 玩家们扮演一群即将或正在劫持各家银行的抢劫犯。在每次抢劫案件中，玩家们从以下五种角色中选择一种：暴徒、恶棍、司机、告密人、谋士。玩家若连续在抢劫案件中使用同一个角色将不会分到赃款；大家需猜测其他玩家的身份，通过忽悠和谈判尽可能的获得更多的赃款。

zh.name: 开溜！
zh.desc: 徒步旅行结束后，您和您的伙伴回到了被讨厌的小动物完全洗劫一空的营地。组队赶在邻居之前清除营地里的小动物吧。Scram！是一款有趣、快速的团队纸牌游戏，可进行 1 vs 2、2 vs 2 和 3 vs 3 三种玩法！

zh.name: 恶夜杀机
zh.desc: Terrorscape 是一款以团队为基础的非对称恐怖游戏。你可以扮演幸存者，也可以扮演杀手。幸存者通过合作寻找 5 把钥匙或修理无线电以拨打紧急电话，从而逃出豪宅。杀手则独自对抗幸存者。杀手需要通过声音或技能找到幸存者，并决定如何消灭他们。

zh.name: 盖亚计划
zh.desc: 在这个没有随机元素的游戏中，每位玩家扮演14个种族其中一个，努力在神秘大地风格的星系中拓展文明。每个种族需要不同的环境才能在星球上生存。因此他们都掌握了改造环境的技术，能够将不同类型的星球转变为适合自己居住的地理环境。

zh.name: 冒险战略：达美安娜之塔
红色的门与杀人鬼的钥匙
害你在心口难开：升级版
茂林源记：森林的权力之战

en.name: Blood Bound
en.desc: Ever since the insidious Gargoyle clan began recruiting more vampires, the domesticated Phoenix clan has had to keep up. The rapid expansion of members and territory by both clans resulted in mutual distrust, scheming, and betrayal. The ensuing war caused the fall of countless immortals, and the massive losses forced the clan leaders into exile.[cite: 1]

en.name: One Night Ultimate Werewolf
en.desc: One Night Ultimate Werewolf is a fast game for 3-10 players in which everyone gets a role: One of the dastardly Werewolves, the tricky Troublemaker, the helpful Seer, or one of a dozen different characters, each with a special ability. In the course of a single morning, your village will decide who is a werewolf...because all it takes is lynching one werewolf to win![cite: 1]

en.name: Night of the Ninja
en.desc: Night of the Ninja is a fast-paced game of deadly secrets, midnight assassinations, and paper-thin alliances. In Night of the Ninja, your mission is to defeat a rival ninja House ...if you can figure out who they are! Each round, you choose your ninja role: a Spy or Fortune Teller gains valuable information, but only a Shinobi or Blind Assassin can cut down an opponent. To win, you’ll have to trick your opponents, figure out who can’t be trusted, and fight for your House![cite: 1]

en.name: The Coach Ride to the Devil's Castle
en.desc: Everyone can feel the coachman's urge to reach the destination quickly, as the passengers in the carriage bear heavy expressions. They belong to two of the most powerful factions, trying to identify their allies before the journey ends. By passing mysterious artifacts, they gather information and clues. To win, they must find and carry enough target treasures while ensuring their team is safe.[cite: 1]

en.name: Blood on the Clocktower
en.desc: Blood on the Clocktower is a social game of deduction and deception, lies and logic, murder and mystery. The game supports 5 to 20 players. During the day, players communicate collectively or privately to gather information, share intelligence, or spread lies. When night falls, players close their eyes, and the demon and its minions awaken to cause mischief in the town.[cite: 1]

en.name: Betrayal at House on the Hill: 3rd Edition
en.desc: The cooperative board game Betrayal at House on the Hill: 3rd Edition includes 50 haunts and dozens of danger-filled rooms that will terrify even the strongest. At first, you will work together, but beware... one explorer will betray the others, and then the haunt begins.[cite: 1]

en.name: Azul
en.desc: Azul tells the story of King Manuel I of Portugal visiting Spain, where he was stunned by the interior decoration of the Alhambra. Feeling inadequate upon his return, he hurriedly summoned artists from all over the country to copy—er, pay homage to—the Spanish artists! You play as these tile-laying artists.[cite: 1]

en.name: Codenames
en.desc: Codenames is a party board game that tests team chemistry and verbal expression.[cite: 1]

en.name: Box Cat (Hakoniwa Neko)
en.desc: This is a city built and inhabited entirely by cats, called "Hakoniwa City". Every building is made out of boxes, which cats love most.[cite: 1]

en.name: Trick-Taking (Da Chi Yi Dun)
en.desc: A multiplayer, fun party card game where the core mechanic is trick-taking. Players must follow suit, and whoever plays the highest card wins all the cards played by other players that round, thus taking the trick.[cite: 1]

en.name: Ito: Rainbow
en.desc: Ito: Rainbow is a game where players choose an appropriate "metaphor" based on a theme to represent the number in their hand, and then sort all players' numbers in ascending order.[cite: 1]

en.name: Abracada...What?
en.desc: A group of greedy wizards arrive at the legendary Archmage's tower. They channel their magic to cast powerful spells to drive away competitors and claim the ancestors' spells. Wait... what's happening? The fireball spell failed! It turned into a freezing storm and then a gentle spring rain![cite: 1]

en.name: Captain Sonar (2022)
en.desc: In Captain Sonar, you and your teammates control a state-of-the-art submarine and are trying to locate an enemy submarine in order to blow it out of the water before they can do the same to you. Every role is important, and the confrontation is merciless. Be organized and communicate because a captain is nothing without his crew: the Chief Mate, the Radio Operator, and the Engineer.[cite: 1]

en.name: Dawn Under
en.desc: Dawn is the busiest time at the local cemetery.[cite: 1]

en.name: Cheating Fish (Lan Yu Chong Shu)
en.desc: Quickly play your cards by bluffing, manage your facial expressions, and be careful not to be exposed by others! If you accidentally show a hint of awkwardness while "cheating", you might end up with a pile of rotten fish cards![cite: 1]

en.name: Brass: Birmingham
en.desc: Britain was the first country to start the Industrial Revolution. The Industrial Revolution began in Britain's textile industry, rather than in other countries or industries, because the British government, through long-term relentless efforts and hard work, created the world's largest textile market, raw material supply bases for wool and cotton, and a global sales network for British enterprises. The prosperity of the First Industrial Revolution promoted the development of ceramics, beer, and processing industries, creating a huge demand for new energy, power, and transportation. Traditional methods were far from enough, so with the British government's financial support, coal, steam engines, and railways experienced explosive growth. Brass: Birmingham tells a legendary story set against this background.[cite: 1]

en.name: Art Society
en.desc: In Art Society, you are an art connoisseur trying to impress your peers by gathering the most fashionable art collection! Bid on the hottest artworks and display them on your living room wall to become the envy of the local art scene.[cite: 1]

en.name: Belaad: The Land of Swords and Quills
en.desc: Belaad: The Land of Swords and Quills is an interpretation of the Golden Age of Islamic countries and the history of Southwest Asia. During this period, many scholars emerged in West Asia, and their novel inventions and scientific discoveries amazed the world. In the palaces, the Sultan and his ministers, realizing the power of knowledge, decided to use scholars to strengthen their rule, monopolize the intellectual class, and seize more benefits. However, a group of insightful civilians saw through the Sultan's intentions, opposed the co-opting of scholars, and helped them use their research for the welfare of the people.[cite: 1]

en.name: Krom: Evolution
en.desc: The village chief has disappeared. Panic! The tribe needs a new leader, but this time, the new leader must be smart (as others say, it will bring change) to evolve the entire human species (that's right)! Naturally, that smart head is yours! Except everyone else thinks the same, leading to battles among the Kroms.[cite: 1]

en.name: Guess Club
en.desc: Travelers from all over the world gather here to compete. They wear mysterious smiles and invite you to join their game. Who has the smartest mind and will be the ultimate winner who laughs last?[cite: 1]

en.name: Nutty Business
en.desc: As a member of a squirrel gang, you must smuggle illegal hazelnut cargo, evade customs officials, protect your goods, and prepare for potential police raids! Once someone runs out of cards, the team with the most hazelnuts becomes the richest gang![cite: 1]

en.name: CABO
en.desc: Spy, swap, and peek to find Cabo the unicorn in this simple card game.[cite: 1]

en.name: Millions of Dollars
en.desc: Players take on the roles of robbers who are about to or are currently robbing banks. For each robbery, players choose one of five roles: Thug, Villain, Driver, Informant, or Mastermind. If a player uses the same role in consecutive robberies, they will not get a share of the loot; everyone must guess other players' identities and obtain as much loot as possible through bluffing and negotiation.[cite: 1]

en.name: Scram!
en.desc: After a hike, you and your partner return to a camp that has been completely ransacked by annoying critters. Team up to clear the critters from your camp before your neighbors do. Scram! is a fun, fast-paced team card game that can be played 1 vs 2, 2 vs 2, and 3 vs 3![cite: 1]

en.name: Terrorscape
en.desc: Terrorscape is a team-based asymmetrical horror game. You can play as a survivor or the killer. Survivors cooperate to find 5 keys or repair the radio to make an emergency call and escape the mansion. The killer faces the survivors alone, locating them through sound or skills, and decides how to eliminate them.[cite: 1]

en.name: Gaia Project
en.desc: In this game with no random elements, each player controls one of 14 factions, striving to expand their civilization in a Mystica-style galaxy. Each faction needs different environmental conditions to survive on a planet. Therefore, they have mastered terraforming technology, capable of transforming different types of planets into suitable living environments.[cite: 1]

en.name: Magical Friends and How to Summon Them
We Didn't Playtest This At All
Red Doors and the Murderer's Key
Legend of the Five Rings: The Card Game
The Castles of Burgundy: Deluxe Edition
